subject: Request: One-time demo credit uplift for Veridian Health – exec approval needed
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Amy Zhao <amy@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-18 10:22 PDT
Subject: Veridian POC - running out of sandbox runway, recommendation for one-off credit

Hannah,

Quick context: Veridian Health (Amy) is mid-POC — they hit a data ingestion snag last week which meant their early tests didn't exercise our embedding/semsearch flows. They now want an extra 45k request-equivalents (~200k tokens equivalent) to finish an expanded scenario set. Under our PLG limits we can only grant a 30-day sandbox with 30k token topups; this request would exceed that.

Why Im escalating: this is a strategic healthcare prospect (pilot across two hospitals). If they finish the extended tests this quarter, we have a good chance at a Dedicated/Reserved conversation H2. Sales is requesting a one-time uplift of credits + a 60-day sandbox extension.

Attachments: veridian-eval-usage.csv (sample usage + gaps)

Proposed ask to execs: one-time 200k token credit, extend sandbox window to 60 days, require PO or signed addendum within 21 days for bookkeeping. No discount to list pricing — purely credit + timeframe variance.

Can you advise next steps / whether to loop in Aditya for signoff?

— Jonas
Account Exec
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-18 11:07 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Veridian POC - running out of sandbox runway, recommendation for one-off credit

Aditya / Jordan — please see Jonas's note and usage file. TL;DR: Veridian needs an extra 200k token-equivalent credit and a 60-day extension to complete a regulatory-facing POC across two hospitals. They are a high-propensity enterprise target but not yet in contract.

Rationale for approval:
- Completing the expanded tests removes a major technical objection (data ingestion / privacy mapping) and unlocks parallel compliance checks they need for procurement.
- If we authorize a one-time non-recurring credit (not a discount), we preserve list pricing and our revenue integrity.
- We should condition approval on: signed addendum / PO by 2028-09-08 and a single-use credit code tied to Veridian account.

Recommended guardrails: 200k token credit, 60-day sandbox extension, require PO/addendum, finance to record as "marketing/strategic POC credit" for tracking.

Requesting exec signoff or clear denial so Sales can communicate promptly.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Strategic Accounts

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-18 14:42 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Veridian POC - running out of sandbox runway, recommendation for one-off credit

Thanks for the context. I support a one-time credit in principle, with the following conditions to protect our revenue and set expectations: 
1) This must be recorded against DEAL-2028-VER-042 as a non-recurring credit (marketing/enablement bucket).
2) The credit code must expire after 60 days and cannot be used for production (only sandbox).
3) Veridian must commit to a PO or signed addendum by 2028-09-08; if they miss that date, the credit is void.
4) SalesOps (Jordan) to confirm the ledger entry and Compliance to confirm that sandbox data controls are acceptable.

Marking this as provisional approval. Jordan/Marissa — please thumbs up if you can operationalize the addendum & ledger entry. If Legal wants to tighten language, loop them in.

-Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-19 09:03 PDT
Subject: RE: Veridian POC - addendum & PO requirements

Hannah / Aditya — we can produce a short addendum that captures: credit amount (200k token-equivalent), window (60 days), scope (sandbox only), non-transferable clause, and expiration/void clause tied to PO by 2028-09-08. I've attached a draft: sow-addendum-v1.docx.

Operational notes: 
- Finance will code this as "promo credit" and attach to the deal record; no revenue recognition impact unless we convert to paid capacity.
- SalesOps (Jordan) — once addendum is signed and PO received, we'll generate the single-use credit code and upload the ledger entry.
- Compliance: I pinged the compliance channel for a quick review of the sandbox controls; early signal is ok given existing SOC2 scope and VPC constraints for this account.

If Aditya confirms, I'll send to Amy and Procurement with a DocuSign link and the PO checklist.

— Marissa
Legal / Deal Desk

From: Amy Zhao <amy@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2028-08-20 08:17 PDT
Subject: Re: Veridian POC - addendum & PO requirements

Thanks — we appreciate the responsiveness. Veridian is prepared to sign an addendum and push a PO through procurement this week. Procurement has asked for the addendum and an invoice-ready reference. I've attached a note of intent: veridian-po-intent.pdf.

Two asks from our side: 
1) Can the credit be applied as soon as the addendum is countersigned (we want to continue testing this week)?
2) Can the invoice reference only the addendum reference (no line-item discount) so procurement can route internally?

We can meet the PO by 2028-08-25 if DocuSign link is live.

— Amy
Senior Product Manager, Veridian Health

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Amy Zhao <amy@veridianhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-21 16:45 PDT
Subject: RE: Veridian POC - addendum & PO requirements — final confirmation

All — final update: Aditya approved the one-time, non-recurring 200k token credit (sandobox-only) conditionally. Marissa has prepared the addendum and will send DocuSign today. Per the guardrails: credit expires 60 days after activation, is single-use, not transferable, and void if PO/addendum not received by 2028-09-08.

Operational next steps (summary):
- Marissa: send DocuSign addendum (sow-addendum-v1.docx) and invoice reference.
- Jordan / Finance: once signed and PO received, generate a single-use credit code and create ledger entry (ticket INC-78421).
- Jonas: confirm activation date with Amy when DocuSign is countersigned.
- Amy/Procurement: send PO by 2028-08-25 so we can fast-track activation.

I'll follow up on the ticket and post the credit code in the HubSpot deal record once issued. Thanks everyone — let's get this moving.

— Hannah
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
